title: Evidence before decisions
say: NOSHASHI helps payment reviewers compare an expectation with public XRP Ledger evidence. This walkthrough uses an archived public payment and clearly labeled teaching examples. No real customer invoice is involved.
caption: Compare the expectation with the evidence. Teaching examples use archived public data.

title: Start with a baseline
say: Start with the exact amount baseline. The example invoice expects the amount that the archived payment delivered. The raw currency code and issuer identify this issued asset. It is not native XRP.
caption: Check the amount, raw currency code, issuer and destination tag together.

title: See what arrived
say: Now the hypothetical invoice expects more than arrived. The result is underpayment. NOSHASHI reads the delivered amount from transaction metadata. It does not substitute the amount the sender requested.
caption: A requested amount is not a delivered amount. This invoice expectation is synthetic.

title: Match the invoice details
say: This example expects a destination tag that the archived payment does not contain. Matching the amount alone is not enough. A reviewer needs to investigate the invoice details before deciding what to do.
caption: An amount can match while the expected destination tag does not.

title: Keep unknowns visible
say: Here the example deliberately removes delivered metadata to simulate missing evidence. The result stays unresolved. Missing data must never turn into a green payment match. This is a simulation, not a live outage.
caption: Unavailable evidence stays UNRESOLVED. This source-failure example is simulated.

title: Review allocation
say: One transaction can be attached to two invoice references. Each amount may match, while the allocation still needs review. The desk flags reused hashes within the session. That warning does not establish fraud.
caption: One payment must not be credited twice without an allocation review.

title: Make an explicit live check
say: For an actual node read, load a teaching expectation into the live desk, then choose Compare with ledger. Review the source, ledger and observation time. This read does not independently verify consensus or authorize funds.
caption: Load an expectation, then explicitly request ledger evidence. No keys or signing.

title: Tell us what is useful
say: Finish with your workflow assessment. What helped? What is missing? Does your current system already do this? Download your feedback and choose whether to share it. Nothing is submitted automatically, and no pilot or meeting is booked.
caption: Evaluate usefulness, record gaps, and download feedback. You control whether to share it.
